   581	      acknowledged_revision = None;
   582	      range;
   583	      raw_contents = anchor_contents;
   584	      last_author = T.Agent;
   585	    }
   586	  in
   587	  DB.Anchors.create db new_anchor |> to_public_anchor db
   588	
   589	let delete_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : unit =
   590	  DB.Anchors.delete db anchor_id
   591	
   592	let get_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : anchor option =
   593	  DB.Anchors.get db anchor_id |> Option.map (to_public_anchor db)
   594	
   595	let get_anchors db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) ~start ~end_ : anchor list
   596	    =
   597	  let doc_meta = get_doc_meta_exn db src_doc in
   598	  DB.Anchors.get_overlapping db doc_meta.doc_id ~start ~end_
   599	  |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)
   600	
   601	let get_all_anchors db : anchor list =
   602	  DB.Anchors.get_all db |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)
   603	
   604	let get_all_current_anchors db : anchor list =
   605	  DB.Anchors.get_all_current db |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)
   606	
   607	let get_all_stale_anchors db : anchor list =
   608	  DB.Anchors.get_all_stale db |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)
   609	
   610	let get_all_anchors_needing_review db : anchor list =
   611	  get_all_stale_anchors db |> List.filter (fun (a : anchor) -> a.needs_review)
   612	
   613	let acknowledge_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : anchor =
   614	  let a =
   615	    match DB.Anchors.get db anchor_id with
   616	    | Some a -> a
   617	    | None ->
   618	        ksprintf failwith "No such anchor: %s"
   619	          (App_types.Anchor_id.to_string anchor_id)
   620	  in
   621	  let doc_meta =
   622	    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db a.doc_id with
   623	    | Some m -> m
   624	    | None ->
   625	        failwith "internal error: anchor references a nonexistent document"
            match Text.get_document_meta store (source_doc "a.ml") with
            | Some (_ : Text.doc_meta) ->
                fail "expected None once soft-deleted"
            | None -> ()));
    Testo.create ~category:cat
      "acknowledge_anchor clears needs_review until the document changes \
       again" (fun () ->
        let target = String.sub big_text 0 60 in
        let files = make_files [ ("a.ml", target) ] in
        with_declared_test_db files (fun store ->
            let (_ : Text.doc_meta), (_ : Text.anchor list) =
              Text.add_file store (source_doc "a.ml") (source files "a.ml")
            in
            let anchor =
              Text.add_anchor store (source_doc "a.ml") (source files "a.ml")
                ~expected_revision:0 ~start:0 ~end_:(String.length target)
            in
                                                                         
                                                       
            Hashtbl.replace files "a.ml"
              "completely unrelated content, nothing like the anchor at all, \
               not even close to a match here";
            let (_ : Text.doc_meta), (_ : Text.anchor list) =
              Text.add_file store (source_doc "a.ml") (source files "a.ml")
            in
            let outdated =
              match Text.get_anchor store anchor.anchor_id with
              | Some a -> a
              | None -> fail "expected to find the anchor"
            in
            Testo.check ~msg:"status" Testo.bool true
              (match outdated.status with
              | Text.Outdated -> true
              | Text.Up_to_date _ -> false);
            Testo.check ~msg:"needs_review before acknowledging" Testo.bool
              true outdated.needs_review;
            let acknowledged =
              Text.acknowledge_anchor store anchor.anchor_id
            in
            Testo.check ~msg:"needs_review right after acknowledging"
              Testo.bool false acknowledged.needs_review;
            if
              List.exists
                (fun (a : Text.anchor) -> a.anchor_id = anchor.anchor_id)
                (Text.get_all_anchors_needing_review store)
            then fail "acknowledged anchor should not need review";
                                                                          
                                   
            Hashtbl.replace files "a.ml"
              "yet another completely unrelated piece of text, still nothing \
               like the original anchor content whatsoever";
            let (_ : Text.doc_meta), (_ : Text.anchor list) =
              Text.add_file store (source_doc "a.ml") (source files "a.ml")
            in
            let reoutdated =
              match Text.get_anchor store anchor.anchor_id with
              | Some a -> a
              | None -> fail "expected to find the anchor"
            in
            Testo.check ~msg:"needs_review again after a further change"
              Testo.bool true reoutdated.needs_review));
  ]

let files_source name =
  match App_types.Source.of_string_opt ("files:" ^ name) with
  | Some s -> s
; Tests for the public Text API, exposed as a library (rather than a
; `test` stanza) so the root tests/ executable can aggregate them alongside
; every other library's test suite. Kept separate from base-libs/shingles
; itself (see Shingles_tests.ml there) since these only need the public
; API and depending on skeletor.shingles here would be circular if they
; lived inside that library.
(library
  (name text_api_tests)
  (libraries
    fpath
    util_tests
    skeletor.text
    skeletor.util
    testo
    sqlite3
  )
)

I found five potential issues in anchor relocation. The first three are **P0** because they can attach an anchor to the wrong evidence or hide an outdated anchor from review.

- **P0 — An intact anchor can move to a duplicate in another file.** Candidate ranking has no preference for the current document, so an unrelated edit can move the anchor to an earlier indexed copy. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:355)
- **P0 — An anchor can cross source boundaries.** The global shingle lookup does not filter by source. Deleting text in one registered source can attach its anchor to matching text in another. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:206)
- **P0 — Relocation can suppress a later review alert.** Relocation preserves `acknowledged_revision` when changing documents; `needs_review` then compares that value with the destination’s revision. Moving to a lower revision can leave a later failed relocation marked as needing no review. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:116) [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:512)
- **P1 — Repeated text can become outdated despite remaining intact.** Indexing drops every occurrence of a repeated shingle, leaving some short anchors with no relocation hits. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:159)
- **P1 — Dense small edits can defeat relocation.** Edits every eight bytes can invalidate every stored 16 byte shingle even when most bytes remain unchanged; an existing test records this limitation. [Text_api_tests.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/tests/Text_api_tests.ml:1060)

These findings come from code and existing tests; I did not run the test suite.
